:::{#thm-dint-harmonic-identity}
#### Harmonic numbers as a double integral

For every positive integer $n$,

$$
\int_0^1 \int_0^1 n(1 - xy)^{n-1}\,dx\,dy
= \sumto{k}{n} \frac{1}{k}
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-miller-dint-harmonic-identity, worked in @sol-miller-dint-harmonic-identity.

:::
